name: com.tencent.android.tpush.rpc.XGRemoteService
description: When the app's push process connects to this Tencent Xinge and TPNS service, it provides the connection used to reach the push service; a start request can also wake that service.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app's separate push process from reaching or waking Tencent's push service, so vendor push messages may stop.
